attchmntText: Dollar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of UAQFR for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Dollar Industries published un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. Standalone total income was 53,730.93 lakhs with net profit of 3,617.85 lakhs. Consolidated total income was 53,927.87 lakhs with net profit of 3,531.76 lakhs. The company reported a scheme of arrangement approved by BSE and NSE in March 2026. The NCLT Kolkata Bench admitted the petition on 14 October 2026 and listed the matter for hearing on 27 November 2026. Ennature Bio Pharma reported standalone total income of 76,4587 lakhs and net profit of 483.68 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Ddev Plastiks Industries reported standalone total income of 97,836.39 lakhs and net profit of 5,196.24 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Manaksia Aluminium reported standalone total income of 12,476.64 lakhs and net profit of 135.31 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: Dollar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Dollar Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for its Q2 FY27 earnings call scheduled for 13th November, 2026 at 4.00 pm IST, organized by Anand Rathi Research. The company reported operating income of Rs. 5,393 Mn for the quarter, a 14.3% year-on-year increase. Gross profit rose 4.5% to Rs. 1,714 Mn with a margin of 31.8%. Operating EBITDA stood at Rs. 605 Mn, with a margin of 11.2%. Profit after tax was Rs. 358 Mn, reflecting a 1.7% year-on-year growth. Earnings per share was Rs. 6.31. The presentation highlighted growth in quick commerce, export business, and specific product segments like Dollar Thermal and Dollar Protect. The schedule of the earnings call remains subject to change.

attchmntText: Dollar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press release in respect of Un-audited Financial Results (Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026".
voiceSummary: Dollar Industries Limited filed a press release regarding its un-audited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors took on record the unaudited financial results for Q2 FY27 on 12th November 2026. Operating income for Q2 FY27 stood at 53,928 Lacs, up 14.3% year-on-year, with an operating EBITDA margin of 11.2%. Profit after tax attributable to owners was 3,579 Lacs, with a PAT margin of 6.6%. Diluted EPS was 6.31. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, operating income was 94,409 Lacs, up 8.4% year-on-year. Profit after tax was 6,181 Lacs, with a margin of 6.5%. Diluted EPS for the half year was 10.90. The company reported growth in quick commerce, winterwear, rainwear, and export segments.

attchmntText: Dollar Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Dollar Industries Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 12, 2026. The standalone profit before tax for the six months ended September 30, 2026, was 8144.12 lakhs, compared to 7314.96 lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share for the six-month period stood at 10.69. The company is proceeding with a Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving the demerger of Dindayal Texpro Private Limited and other entities. The National Company Law Tribunal, Kolkata Bench, admitted the petition on October 14, 2026, and listed the matter for hearing on November 27, 2026. Shareholder approval for the scheme was previously endorsed. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report confirming no material misstatements in the financial results.
